notes: S3 (blob codes; decision 2026-11-16 #44; MW2 reviews A and B): the hexadecimal part has 129 characters; §2.7 allows at most 128, so this is not a digest string (a well-formed sha512 digest is E_MANIFEST_BLOB, see blobs-listing-unsupported-algorithm).
